Story time:

Taking a road trip around the western United States, I'd left Los Angeles around 2 and got to my camp site at Big Sur after dark and apparently after most people had gone to bed. I was alone on the trip because I had just dumped the girlf a couple months prior. I set my tent up in the dark in a windy 40º weather. I had a good sleeping bag and I'd set my tent up with the door away from the wind, so I could leave the rain fly cracked wide. That was THE BEST SLEEP I've ever had. When I woke up and went out to start the coffee fire, I noticed I was setup under the biggest tree I'd ever seen. A California Redwood. Wide. Tall. Old. Proud.

Best night ever. Best coffee ever. The redwood forests on the west coast are truly enchanting.
